title: Autonomous Goal-Driven Personas, High-Fidelity Telemetry Modal, and Global Graphify Integration
description: Overhaul the persona generation engine to replace rigid [CATALYST FOR CHANGE] blocks with dynamic [CORE GOALS & INCENTIVES]. This allows LLM agents to autonomously evaluate feature proposals against their specific incentives. Enforce realistic human name generation via fallback registries to eliminate role-based cognitive bias. Implement a neobrutalist three-tab UI details modal displaying real-time spawning telemetry (Agent ID, Parent ID, model badge, active thread), OCEAN progress bars, and an interactive horizontal Buyer Journey stepper. Finally, integrate the graphifyy package globally to enable assistant slash commands for codebase structure mapping.
target_users: Software Architects, Product Managers, Security Compliance Auditors
pricing_strategy: Value-based pricing for Enterprise Grid tier
